post.subject: Version 4.4 Event Warp: Phase I
post.structured_content:
[{"insert":{"image":"https://upload-os-bbs.hoyolab.com/upload/2026/07/13/bb2f4587858937d2d5ce45d7baa6d2b9_4514235875515648757.png"},"attributes":{"align":"img-center","height":1080,"width":1920,"size":"4941864"}},{"insert":"Hello, Trailblazers!

▌"Ad Astra Nova" and "Brilliant Fixation: A Star That Lights the Night" Event Warps"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● During the "Ad Astra Nova" Character Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star character Himeko • Nova (Erudition: Fire) and 4-star characters Moze (The Hunt: Lightning), Hanya (Harmony: Physical), and Serval (Erudition: Lightning) will be boosted for a limited time.
● During the "Brilliant Fixation: A Star That Lights the Night" Light Cone Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star Light Cone A Star That Lights the Night (Erudition) and 4-star Light Cones After the Charmony Fall (Erudition), Under the Blue Sky (Destruction), and The Birth of the Self (Erudition) will be boosted for a limited time.

▌"Indelible Coterie: Sparxie" and "Coalesced Truths: Dazzled by a Flowery World" Event Warps"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● During the "Indelible Coterie: Sparxie" Character Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star character Sparxie (Elation: Fire) and 4-star characters Moze (The Hunt: Lightning), Hanya (Harmony: Physical), and Serval (Erudition: Lightning) will be boosted for a limited time.
● During the "Coalesced Truths: Dazzled by a Flowery World" Light Cone Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star Light Cone Dazzled by a Flowery World (Elation) and 4-star Light Cones After the Charmony Fall (Erudition), Under the Blue Sky (Destruction), and The Birth of the Self (Erudition) will be boosted for a limited time.

▌"Indelible Coterie: Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae" and "Coalesced Truths: Though Worlds Apart" Event Warps"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● During the "Indelible Coterie: Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae" Character Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star character Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae (Preservation: Physical) and 4-star characters Moze (The Hunt: Lightning), Hanya (Harmony: Physical), and Serval (Erudition: Lightning) will be boosted for a limited time.
● During the "Coalesced Truths: Though Worlds Apart" Light Cone Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star Light Cone Though Worlds Apart (Preservation) and 4-star Light Cones After the Charmony Fall (Erudition), Under the Blue Sky (Destruction), and Birth of the Self (Erudition) will be boosted for a limited time.

▌"Indelible Coterie: Evernight" and "Coalesced Truths: To Evernight's Stars" Event Warps"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● During the "Indelible Coterie: Evernight" Character Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star character Evernight (Remembrance: Ice) and 4-star characters Moze (The Hunt: Lightning), Hanya (Harmony: Physical), and Serval (Erudition: Lightning) will be boosted for a limited time.
● During the "Coalesced Truths: To Evernight's Stars" Light Cone Event Warp, the drop rates of the limited 5-star Light Cone To Evernight's Stars (Remembrance) and 4-star Light Cones After the Charmony Fall (Erudition), Under the Blue Sky (Destruction), and The Birth of the Self (Erudition) will be boosted for a limited time.

"},{"insert":{"image":"https://upload-os-bbs.hoyolab.com/upload/2026/07/13/577362a13919859878322d1743ae864e_8554336666466076595.jpg"},"attributes":{"align":"img-center","height":1350,"width":1080,"size":"323193"}},{"insert":"
▌ Event Warp Details"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"※ Among the above characters and Light Cones, limited characters and limited Light Cones will not be available in the Stellar Warp event.
※ In this phase of Warp, obtainable 5-star characters include the featured 5-star characters and the custom-selected characters from "Celestial Invitation."
※ During the Event Warp, the limited 5-star character Himeko • Nova (Erudition: Fire) can only be obtained from the "Ad Astra Nova" Character Event Warp, while the limited 5-star characters Sparxie (Elation: Fire), Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae (Preservation: Physical), and Month of Evernight (Remembrance: Ice) can only be obtained from the corresponding "Indelible Coterie" Character Event Warps.
※ During the Event Warp, the limited 5-star Light Cone "A Star That Lights the Night (Erudition)" can only be obtained from the "Brilliant Fixation: A Star That Lights the Night" Light Cone Event Warp. The limited 5-star Light Cones "Dazzled by a Flowery World (Elation)", "Though Worlds Apart (Preservation)", and "To Evernight's Stars (Remembrance)" can only be obtained from the corresponding "Coalesced Truths" Light Cone Event Warp.
※ "Ad Astra Nova" and "Indelible Coterie" are Character Event Warps that share the same guaranteed drop counter. The cumulative Warp count for a guaranteed 5-star character in any Character Event Warp will always be carried over to other Character Event Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.
※ "Brilliant Fixation" and "Coalesced Truths" are considered Light Cone Event Warps, and share the same guaranteed drop counter. The cumulative Warp count for a guaranteed 5-star Light Cone in any Light Cone Event Warp will always be carried over to other Light Cone Event Warps, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Warps.
※ The "Indelible Coterie" Character Event Warp and the "Coalesced Truths" Light Cone Event Warp will irregularly become available in future version updates. For more details, please stay tuned for official announcements.
※ The 4-star characters and Light Cones with increased drop rates in Phase 1 and Phase 2 of Version 4.4's Warp events will remain unchanged.
※ For more information, please head to the Warp screen.

▌ "Aptitude Showcase" Character Trial Event"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● Requirement: Unlock Travel Log
Event Details: After the Version 4.4 update on 2026/07/15 – 2026/08/25 15:00 (server time), trial characters Himeko • Nova (Erudition: Fire), Moze (The Hunt: Lightning), Hanya (Harmony: Physical), and Serval (Erudition: Lightning) can be used to experience the stages. After the Version 4.4 update – 2026/08/05 11:59 (server time), trial characters Sparxie (Elation: Fire), Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae (Preservation: Physical), and Evernight (Remembrance: Ice) can be used to experience the stages. Upon completing the challenges, you can obtain Stellar Jades, Adventure Logs, Universal Enhancement Materials, and credits as rewards.

▌ "Celestial Invitation" Custom Characters"},{"insert":"
","attributes":{"header":4}},{"insert":"● Trailblazers can customize 7 "Celestial Invitation" characters in the Character Event Warp. The selectable characters are as follows.
※ The first time you obtain a 5-star character in this Warp event, there is a 50% chance that it will be one of the featured 5-star characters. There is also a 50% chance that it will be any of the obtainable 5-star characters in this Warp phase, with equal chance among them.
※ If the Celestial Invitation characters include this phase's featured 5-star character, when you fail to trigger the 50% chance to immediately obtain the featured 5-star character, you will obtain 1 character from the featured character and 7 Celestial Invitation characters. The Celestial Invitation characters each have a consistent 12.5% drop rate while the featured character is at 25%.
※ Regardless of whether you trigger the featured guarantee, it will be reset when you obtain the featured character.
"}]
